notes: Clark University Global Scholars Program Scholarship is an undergraduate merit award administered by the Office of Financial Assistance (contact finaid@clarku.edu - office, not faculty). Official Clark pages list the five international first-year merit scholarships and state applicants are automatically considered; no supervising or program faculty member is named anywhere on the scholarship/FAQ pages. Undergraduate merit scholarship has no named supervisor by design.

Invest Your Talent in Italy is a MAECI (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) scheme run with ICE and Uni-Italia. Applications and selection are handled entirely by the IYT Technical Committee via the esteri.it portal (contact dgce07.iyt@esteri.it); applicants choose from published English-taught Master's/Postgraduate courses at participating Italian universities, but the scholarship attaches to no specific institution or professor.

ARES 'bourses de formations internationales' is a government scholarship of the Federation Wallonie-Bruxelles administered by ARES. The official call (ares-ac.be) lists eligible specialised bachelor/specialised master/continuing-education programmes across FWB institutions, but the award is tied to no single institution or named professor; programme contact is the ARES coordination service (scholarships-cooperation@ares-ac.be).

Boren Scholarships/Fellowships are a federal National Security Education Program (DLNSEO) run through borenawards.org and administered with IIE. Recipients choose their own overseas programme and campus advisors (campus representatives, not supervisors); no institution or supervising professor is attached to the award.

Kyushu University Friendship Scholarship (JPY 80,000/month stipend) is the university's own support scheme for privately financed exchange, special auditing, special research and double-degree students. The official Kyushu pages state 'If you wish to receive this scholarship, please contact and apply for it through your prospective host department at Kyushu University' - i.e., via the host department, with no named professor or faculty supervisor published; program office email is intlr-pscholar@jimu.kyushu-u.ac.jp (International Student Exchange Division, not faculty).

University of Leeds Masters International Excellence Scholarships is an automatic-track merit award for international students holding an offer for eligible taught Masters courses; awarded by the University via the Admissions process (contact study@leeds.ac.uk, not faculty). Verified on the official scholarship page: no named supervising professor or programme faculty is attached to the award.

TU/e Scholarship for Excellence (Shaping the Future of Microchip Innovation) is a university merit scholarship for Master's programmes in Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering and Mathematics & Computer Science. The official page states selection is made by a Scholarship Selection Committee 'consisting of: Rector Magnificus, Dean of Education, Director Finance & Control, and Director Education & Student Affairs' - university administrators, not named supervising professors; contact is io@tue.nl (International Office). No professor named for any eligible programme.
